name: agent_env
_repo_root_comment: Unified 2026-08-24 (owner order): the g0 worktree is retired, agent_env carries main and is the only checkout. History: main lived in agent_env_g0 from the 2026-08-22 fork ruling until the unification merge 9831ddae.
_center_comment: Daedalus distilling ITSELF. The center is the shipping product: the Python package plus the cockpit source. Everything else in the repo is shell -- runs/, inbox/, outbox/, memory/ are runtime state; templates/ and agents/ are data; daedalus.egg-info/ is build metadata; structcore-rs/ is the second engine and has its own toolchain. Shell stays resolvable as an import target, so edges from daedalus/ into it remain true.
_ignore_comment: @tests is the built-in test-file preset. Tests are real code but not distillation targets, and on the sibling project they were half the files and 392 of the duplication clusters. eval/fixtures are corpora, not source.

policy._comment: agent_env holds no lab IP, but it DOES hold the harness's own secrets handling. Deny the things that would leak a key or a device path if a slice of this repo were ever sent out.
